description: Fetch one ad in full by its id or URL: what linkedin/ads gives, and where it was seen, country by country, with its targeting. Give exactly one of `id` or `url`. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

id.description: The Ad Library's id for the ad: `id` in linkedin/ads.

url.description: The ad's page in the Ad Library: `https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/detail/<id>`.

name: get_linkedin_ad
title: Get one ad from LinkedIn's Ad Library
